extra.location_text: Entrance to New York Bay, Off Sandy Hook
extra.position_note: Position printed in the Light List: Atlantic and Gulf Coasts of the United States, 1900 (Light-House Board), page 74, entry 353: Scotland Light-Vessel, No. 7, 40 26 48 N, 73 55 17 W (the seconds are in brackets: the position varies somewhat). Location as printed: Moored in 68 feet of water, off the entrance to New York Bay, on the southeasterly prolongation of the axis of the South and Swash channels, about 3 3/8 miles SE. 3/8 S. from its intersection with the axis of Main Channel.
